name: Whitepages
instructions: Whitepages confirms by phone, so you need to do this one. Open whitepages.com/suppression-requests, paste {listing_url}, press Next, then "Remove Me". Pick a reason, press Next, and enter the phone number Whitepages shows for you. Answer the automated call and enter the code it gives you. When the page says your request was received, press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's White Pages entry; page steps per Blake104/OptOut (AGPL-3.0) whitepages.yml, verified upstream 2026-05-10.
notes: 411.com uses the same opt-out. Whitepages Premium listings may need a separate request through Whitepages support. Listings can come back within about 90 days.
